reuse.why: Extends the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate that getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend already use, but does not export it to replace the separate inline holiday check in server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange, which keeps the old exact-day-only rule.

duplication.why: The diff adds no duplicated logic, but it leaves the pre-existing parallel holiday test (`config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date))`) in getDatesInRange untouched, so the rule now differs between the two copies.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule is changed in shared/schedules.ts, the module that owns weekend/holiday date handling.

scope.why: A minimal change to one predicate plus a focused test.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; a maintainer must still know about the second holiday check in schedules/app.ts, which this change missed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff edits the shared predicate itself; the bypassing inline check in schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange predates it and was simply not routed through it.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated by the diff.
